title: The morphism functor from a finite locally free scheme is representable by a scheme

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the statement

standard_prerequisites.name: Representability when the source is finite free over an affine base
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: chapter lemma lemma-hom-from-finite-locally-free-into-affine, cited in the proof
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the local model: over an affine piece of S the functor is representable by an affine scheme.

standard_prerequisites.name: Glueing functors
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Schemes, lemma schemes-lemma-glue-functors, cited in the proof
standard_prerequisites.use: Glues the local representing objects along the affine opens of S into a scheme representing the whole functor.

standard_prerequisites.name: Affineness of finitely many points in a fibre
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: hypothesis (2) of the statement, used at proof lines 20206-20208 and 20241-20247
standard_prerequisites.use: Ensures that any finite set of points in a fibre of X over S lies in an affine open, which is exactly what the local representability needs to cover the functor.

core_obligations: 对 S 的仿射开覆盖逐片使用有限局部自由情形的表示性，得到局部的表示对象 U_i。
用假设 (2) 证明任意点 t ∈ T 都属于某个由局部数据定义的 U_{i,b}，即这些开集覆盖整个函子。
把局部表示对象沿仿射开集的交粘合（glue functors）。
得到 Mor_S(Z, X) 被一个概型表示。
proof_roadmap: 把底 S 化为仿射并用有限局部自由情形取得局部表示（证明 20213-约20240 行）。
用假设 (2) 验证局部开集覆盖函子的每个点（20241-20247 行）。
沿仿射开集粘合局部表示对象（约20248-20253 行）。
difficulty_reason: 命题说当 Z -> S 有限局部自由、且 X 的每个纤维中任意有限多个点都落在某个仿射开集中时，函子 Mor_S(Z, X) 可由概型表示。证明分三步：在 S 的仿射片上调用有限自由情形（局部模型）、用假设 (2) 证明局部开集 U_{i,b} 覆盖函子的每个点、最后用粘合函子的引理把局部表示粘成整体。不能一眼完成的是第二步的覆盖验证：需要把「某点的像落在某个 U_i 中」翻译成纤维中有限点集的仿射性。原文位于第 20200–20254 行。
